findings.evidence: After each remediation the candidate already receives independent Reviewer and Challenger review before Adjudication; a second Final Challenger and second Final Adjudication inspect unchanged bytes and add latency without a distinct authority boundary.
affected_clauses: v2.6 reference algorithm final challenge loop
findings.minimal_revision: Use one fresh clean-room Challenger in every review cycle and route an Adjudicator decision with no accepted P0/P1 directly to Human Final Confirmation.
findings.compatibility: Completed and already-started v2.6/v0.7 runs retain their frozen authority. New runs use v2.7/v0.8.
regression_scenarios: Initial candidate with no accepted P0/P1 uses one Challenger and one Adjudicator before human confirmation.
Every Developer remediation runs verification, Reviewer, a new clean-room Challenger, and Adjudicator.
Document P0/P1 stops for Document Owner and human approval.
Accepted P2 remains visible after later empty decisions.
Only Developer can mutate product bytes.
Human confirmation binds the exact candidate snapshot SHA.
